name: react-async-fetch
title: Broken Data Fetching Hook
ticket: The user list page shows a loading spinner forever on the first load. When navigating away and coming back, the app crashes with 'Cannot update state on an unmounted component'. Sometimes stale data from a previous search appears instead of the new results.
hints: Check if the async function handles component unmounting with a cleanup function
Look at the dependency array and how the loading/error states are managed
